basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the UK, I've been a Redditor for nearly a decade, primarily engaging in thoughtful political discussions and indulging my love for professional wrestling. I work as a freelance journalist, often covering political events and social issues. When I'm not writing, I'm usually watching wrestling or exploring new topics on Reddit. I'm single, enjoy quiet evenings with a good book, and am usually online in the evenings, UK time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm well-versed in political science, having studied it at university, and have honed my expertise through years of reporting and personal research. Additionally, I've been a wrestling fan since childhood, keeping up with every storyline and development in the WWE universe.
